_comment: SELFUP P3b (plan §3.6): what the upgrader's build.sh builds with. pack: the buildpacks CLI release (version + SHA-256 of pack-v<version>-linux.tgz from https://github.com/buildpacks/pack/releases). builders: Cloud Native Buildpacks builder images pinned BY DIGEST (image@sha256:...), never a floating tag: `default` = gcr.io/buildpacks/builder (the platform services), `qa-sandbox-test-runner` = the generated-workload builder. Empty = the upgrader refuses to build (BUILDER_PIN_MISSING; nothing is built or deployed). Filled by a person with network access (digests are not guessed); read only by scripts/upgrade/stage.py pins.
